# Standalone publication decision

Decision: **GO as a standalone technical note.**

Gate passed: the manuscript proves a general requested-derivative-order
theorem with explicit computable constants. The result is supported by an
endpoint atlas, normalized-tail theorem, exact-rational order-eight
certificate, and independent verifier.

The decision does not rest on a priority claim or on the numerical sharpness
of the constants. If external review identifies a substantially identical
theorem, the note can still be merged into Paper 02 as a self-contained
analytic appendix without changing any proof dependency.
